items.label: Painted gyp board ceiling, two levels - 8'-10" and 8'-2"
items.instanceNote: ⚑ Three sheets, three heights: A120 (Rev 4) tags 8'-10" and 8'-2" (two levels); A510.2 (same Rev 4) tags 9'-0" - the draft PT-07 reading; ID-1.6 gives 9'-2". The 8'-2" low zone likely corresponds to the soffit A510.2 notes at the breakfast/servery edge, but the field height (8'-10" vs 9'-0" vs 9'-2") is unresolved - check A120 vs A510.2 vs ID-1.6. System (painted gyp) agrees on A120 and ID-1.6 (PT-07).
